title: The operators and the interrogative witnesses

statements.text: The apparatus has fifteen operators (THIS, SAME and NOT-SAME, NO, IF and THEN, BECAUSE, INSIDE and OUTSIDE, NEAR and FAR, CAN and CANNOT, MAYBE, MUST and LET, TOGETHER and ALONE, MORE and LESS, GOES-WITH, MANY and ONE, EVERY and SOME) and seven interrogative witnesses (WHAT, WHERE, WHICH, WHEN, FOR-WHAT, HOW, WHENCE). They are presented as derived, not taken from natural language.

sources.quote: First, fifteen operators were derived through structural-categorial analysis and through empirical probing.
The witnesses are: WHAT, WHERE, WHICH, WHEN, FOR-WHAT, HOW, WHENCE.
